eyebrow: Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR & KQL · Chapter 2
subtitle: Lesson 6 · KQL Fundamentals

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType != "0"
caption: Two where clauses stack as an AND — only rows from the last day with a failed result type survive.

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType != "0"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, ResultType
caption: project keeps only the columns you list, in the order you list them — everything else is dropped.

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType != "0"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| take 50
caption: take returns an arbitrary sample of up to 50 rows — useful for a quick look, not a reliable top-N list.
